historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_5yr_cagr (FY2020 1,294.6 -> FY2025 1,990.9); equity CAGR is not computable because shareholders' equity has been negative since FY2021 (buybacks in excess of earnings), and the EPS CAGR is inflated by the ~19% share-count reduction and by the FY2025-26 mortgage-price step-ups.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR unusable (negative book value from FY2021: -111 -> -4,097 at Jun-2026). EPS 5yr CAGR 27% vs revenue 9% -- the gap is buybacks (29.9M -> 22.7M shares) plus operating leverage on score pricing. FY2026E revenue growth of ~27% is a pricing event (mortgage score $4.95 -> $10.00) and is not in any trailing CAGR; the base path assumes it does not repeat.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF CAGRs are on reported FCF - SBC - equity-award taxes (interest income immaterial throughout). 3yr owner-FCF CAGR of 6.6% (FY2022 337.1 -> FY2025 408.6) is far below the 15.2% reported-FCF CAGR: equity-award tax withholding grew from 50.9 to 204.6 as the share price ran from ~$400 to ~$2,000, so an increasing share of reported cash-flow growth was being consumed by the cash cost of equity comp. The 5yr owner series (FY2020 146.3 -> 408.6, 22.8%) starts from a low base year in which equity taxes were 102.9 on FCF of 342.9. Reported FCF 5yr CAGR 17.5%.

scenario_narratives.base: The mortgage-score price doubling to $10.00 (Jan 2026) sticks but is the LAST step-up for the foreseeable future: under FTC/DOJ and Congressional attention FICO holds the price, takes one more quarter of carryover in FY2027 (+12% revenue), and then grows Scores on volume, modest auto/card pricing and B2C, while Software compounds high-single digits as the FICO Platform (ARR +62%, 148% NRR) overtakes the shrinking legacy book. Adj. EBITDA settles at 63%; equity comp glides from 10.5% to 8.5% of revenue as the withholding-tax component normalises at a lower share price. The 5.6B of buyback-funded debt is serviceable (~4x FY2027 EBITDA) and rolls down as FCF is redirected from repurchases.
scenario_narratives.bull: Regulatory scrutiny produces hearings but no remedy; the March 2026 reversal of the FHFA bi-merge mandate holds. FICO takes another mortgage price step in 2027, Fed cuts revive origination volume from its ~40%-below-normal trough, the Direct Licensing Program is certified (reseller agreements already cover ~60% of mortgage volume) and Score 10T/UltraFICO extend the franchise. Platform ARR keeps growing 40%+ with the Accenture channel, pushing Software to low-teens growth. Revenue +18% in FY2027 fading to 5%; margins reach 65.5%. The levered balance sheet becomes a tailwind as the market re-rates toward the 30x+ non-GAAP P/E the stock carried in 2025.
scenario_narratives.bear: The antitrust track bites: a DOJ/FTC consent order, an FHFA 'lender's choice' rule, or a settled class action forces a ~50% rollback of the $10 mortgage price in FY2028 while VantageScore captures ~20% of mortgage pulls. Because mortgage royalties (~30% of revenue) carry ~100% incremental margin, revenue falls 10% and adj. EBITDA drops to ~50%. Growth thereafter is volume plus inflation at a regulated toll. The 5.9B of notes issued to buy back stock at $1,300-1,800 becomes the story: net debt/EBITDA rises toward 5x, buybacks stop, and the equity absorbs the full swing -- this is the scenario in which the FY2026 leveraged repurchase program destroyed value.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value FICO as an unlevered owner-FCF stream on a strict basis -- GAAP SBC and the cash taxes paid to settle equity awards are both charged, the share count is held flat, and no further mortgage-score price step-up is assumed in the base case while the regulatory track is live. The FY2026 pricing windfall is treated as a level shift already in the base, not a growth rate. The debt taken on to fund $3B of FY2026 buybacks is deducted at face, which is what makes the equity's bear case steep relative to the revenue bear case. The house (SBC-expensed) and street (SBC as non-cash) values bracket where the market is pricing the accounting regime.
key_risks_to_valuation: Regulatory remedy on mortgage-score pricing (DOJ/FTC consent order, FHFA lender's-choice or bi-merge rule, class-action settlement) -- the bear-case axis and the largest single swing factor
VantageScore share gains in mortgage beyond the low-20s management believes gaming dynamics cap it at
Leverage: 5.6B net debt at ~5.6x TTM owner FCF and ~4x forward EBITDA; a revenue shock passes straight through to equity and constrains the buyback that has held the count flat

Equity-comp charge: if FICO's share price recovers, net-share-settlement taxes rise back toward the FY2025 level (10% of revenue) and the owner-FCF margin falls -- the model's SBC glide assumes a ~$900 vesting price
Mortgage origination volume stays ~40% below normal for longer if rates remain elevated; volume is the only non-pricing lever in Scores
Platform migration executes below plan: non-platform ARR is declining 17% a year, so any stumble in Platform ARR shows up as flat total software revenue
Terminal value is ~60% of EV in the base case at a 9% WACC; each 1pp of WACC moves value by roughly 15-20%

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API regularMarketPrice at inputs.price_as_of (Friday 2026-09-25 regular close, re-fetched 2026-09-28 pre-open and unchanged); 52-week range 848.64-1998.01, so the price is within 2% of its 52-week low after a ~40% YTD decline.
data_sources.financials: research/FICO/Reports/FICO_Metrics.csv (SEC XBRL companyfacts, 105 periods through the Jun-2026 10-Q; metrics_normalized in USD millions). Balance sheet and diluted share count from the Q3 FY2026 10-Q (2026-06-30). Buybacks, equity-award taxes, cash taxes, D&A and deferred revenue from the kpis table. FY2026 guidance ($2.53B revenue, $850M GAAP NI, $36.86 GAAP EPS, $979M / $42.43 non-GAAP) from the Q3 FY2026 release as recorded in FICO_Analysis.json.
data_sources.qualitative: research/FICO/Reports/FICO_Analysis.json (2026-09-28): segment mix, Platform ARR, mortgage pricing history ($0.60 -> $10.00 over five years), Hawley/FTC/DOJ investigation, FHFA bi-merge reversal, VantageScore dynamics, Accenture partnership, DLP status.

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026E = management guidance of $2.53B (raised at Q3 FY2026, Aug 2026). 9M FY2026 actual revenue 1,877.8 (H1 1,203.6 + Q3 674.2) implies Q4 of ~652, in line with Q3's 674 less the flagged Q4 opex/seasonal softness. FY0 is the fiscal year ending 2026-09-30, two days after the valuation date, so year 1 = FY2027 and the 2026-06-30 balance sheet does not double-count FY2026 cash generation.
inputs.share_count_basis: Q3 FY2026 (Jun-2026 quarter) diluted weighted-average shares, 22.703M (GAAP EPS 10.45 x 22.70M = 237.2M NI ties). Held FLAT: SBC (and equity-award taxes) are fully expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would charge the same cost twice. Being a weighted average through a quarter of heavy repurchases it slightly overstates the period-end diluted count -- conservative.
inputs.sbc_source: SEC XBRL via Metrics.csv: ShareBasedCompensation cash-flow add-back (TTM to 2026-06-30 = FY2025 156.7 - 9M FY2025 124.3 + 9M FY2026 141.9 = 174.3) PLUS taxes paid related to net-share settlement of equity awards (TTM = FY2025 204.6 - 9M FY2025 203.2 + 9M FY2026 111.3 = 112.7). FICO publishes no combined 'SBC related to equity awards' line, so the two are summed. FY2025 full year was 156.7 + 204.6 = 361.3 (18.1% of revenue) -- the equity-award tax line was inflated by RSUs vesting at $1,500-2,000 share prices; the TTM ratio is 12.0% of TTM revenue (2,393.6).
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing-activity repurchases 1,414.5; 9M FY2026 repurchases 3,046.0, funded by ~2.2B of new debt (total debt 3,596.6 at 2025-09-30 -> 5,882.4 at 2026-06-30). The flat share count is fully funded -- FICO is a serial repurchaser -- but the funding has shifted from FCF to leverage, which is why net debt is now ~5.6x TTM owner FCF and the bear case carries the balance sheet.
inputs.fy0_note: FY0 revenue is the FY2026 guidance estimate (fiscal year ends 2026-09-30); last_fcf / reported_fcf / sbc are the trailing twelve months to 2026-06-30, the latest four FILED quarters.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in USD, the flows' own currency. Cost of equity: 10y UST ~4.2% + beta ~1.25 x ERP 5.0% = ~10.4%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~5.8% (FY2025-26 senior notes 5.6-6.4%), ~4.5% after tax. Weights at market: equity 22.70M x 863 = 19.6B, net debt 5.6B -> D/V ~22%. WACC = 0.78 x 10.4 + 0.22 x 4.5 = 9.1%, rounded to 9.0% and held identical across scenarios: regulatory risk is charged once, through the bear path and its 25% weight, not again through the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Operating leases (ASC 842, ~$30-40M liabilities) are expensed inside GAAP operating expenses, so the lease cost already sits inside the EBITDA margin path. Lease liabilities are therefore NOT added to net debt (one treatment, never two). No finance leases of note.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (dcf-methods routing row 1: operating company, software/data). FICO is a US operating company -- a royalty-like credit-score toll (Scores ~63% of revenue, ~100% incremental margin) plus a decisioning-software business transitioning to the FICO Platform (ARR +62%). No memory entry existed; first valuation. Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - equity-award taxes - interest income; interest income is immaterial because FICO is a net DEBTOR (5.6B), so nothing is stripped and the cash pile is not counted twice. The projections are UNLEVERED (EBIT taxed at the cash rate, no interest deduction) and discounted at WACC; last_fcf (709) is the LEVERED TTM owner FCF, so year-1 projected FCF exceeds it by roughly after-tax interest (~$220-330M pre-tax on 5.9B of notes) plus the FY2027 margin step -- that gap is expected, not a carry-forward error. Component build FY2026E check: adj. EBITDA ~60.5% (GAAP EBITDA ~53% + SBC ~7.5%; non-GAAP op margin guided ~62% at the Q3 run-rate before the Q4 Accenture-marketing/restructuring bump), SBC+equity taxes ~12%, D&A 0.6%, capex 0.4-0.5%. XBRL quarterly labels in the Metrics pivot are shifted one quarter for this September FY (the row labelled Q2 2026 is the Jun-2026 quarter = Q3 FY2026); H1/9M cumulative rows were used for all TTM arithmetic. FY2026 is near-certain (9 months filed, guidance raised) so the judgment starts at FY2027; the single axis that matters is mortgage-score pricing under FTC/DOJ/Congressional scrutiny, and the balance sheet (levered buybacks) is what turns a revenue bear case into a steep equity bear case.

bear.growth_rationale: FY2027 +3% as the price carryover is offset by early dual-score pulls; FY2028 -10% when a DOJ/FTC consent order or FHFA 'lender's choice' rule forces a ~50% rollback of the $10 mortgage price (mortgage ~30% of revenue at ~100% margin) and VantageScore takes ~20% of mortgage volume; FY2029 -2% as auto/card pricing also freezes; then a regulated-utility 3% -- volume plus inflation. Margin 50%: revenue lost is almost all profit, and SBC does not fall with revenue. Terminal cap 15x: a price-regulated toll, not a compounder.

base.growth_rationale: FY2027 +12%: one extra quarter of the $10 mortgage price (Q1 FY2026 was still at $4.95) adds ~6pp to Scores on its own; low-single-digit origination volume, mid-single-digit auto/card price increases, flat B2C, Software +8% (total ARR +10%, Platform +62% offsetting non-platform -17%). NO further mortgage-price step-up is assumed while the FTC/DOJ/Hawley scrutiny is live. Decelerates 10 -> 4.5% as pricing normalises to volume-plus-inflation and Platform matures.
base.margin_rationale: Adj. (pre-SBC) EBITDA 61.5% in FY2027 vs ~60.5% FY2026E and the ~62.5% Q3 FY2026 run-rate; plateau 63% -- Scores mix at ~100% incremental margin lifts it, Accenture go-to-market spend and Platform hosting cost cap it. FY2025 actual was 55.1%, FY2024 52.2%.
base.sbc_rationale: Total equity-comp charge (GAAP SBC + net-share-settlement taxes) 10.5% of revenue in FY2027 vs 12.0% TTM and 18.1% FY2025: GAAP SBC ~7.3% -> 6.0% with scale; the tax-withholding component falls from ~4.5% to ~3% because the FY2024-25 grants vest at today's ~$860 rather than the $1,500-2,000 at which the FY2025 cohort vested. Glide to 8.5%.
base.tax_rationale: Cash tax 21% rising to 23%: FY2025 cash taxes 162 on ~830 pre-tax (19.5%) benefited from excess equity-award deductions that shrink at a lower share price; 23% = 21% federal + ~2-3% state/foreign net of R&D credits.
base.wc_rationale: Working capital consumes ~10% of the revenue increase: receivables (score royalties billed in arrears) grow faster than deferred revenue (FY2025 deferred revenue +30 on a +273 revenue increase; OCF - (NI + SBC + D&A) was -45 in FY2025 and -43 in FY2024).

bull.growth_rationale: Scrutiny fades without action; a further 2027 mortgage price rise (e.g. $10 -> $12) plus a rate-cut-driven origination recovery (volumes are ~40% below the 2019-21 norm) and Direct Licensing Program certification lift Scores +25%; Platform ARR keeps compounding 40%+ so Software accelerates to low-teens. Fades to 5% by year 10.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 20x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: FICO is a single-regulator dependency (FHFA/GSE underwriting rules) with an open Congressional investigation, formal referrals to the FTC and DOJ Antitrust Division, and ~10 private antitrust suits past summary judgment -- and a levered balance sheet that amplifies any revenue outcome into the equity. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent things to go right at once: no regulatory remedy AND a further price increase AND a mortgage-volume recovery AND Platform sustaining 40%+ ARR growth. Base 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)
